desc:
Step into the medieval world of historic book arts in this hands-on painting course. Learn to draw traditional motifs, paint with gouache, and create an ornate border surrounding a poem — through pattern, colour, and storytelling.

Guided by Professional Artist Nora Alkeyat. Templates and materials provided. Every student receives a FREE Medieval Drawing Workbook.
18+ | Sisters only
Saturday Sept 26 & Oct 3 (2-classes) | 12pm - 2pm
Meadowvale Community Centre, Program Room 2 | 6655 Glen Erin Dr, Mississauga
location: 6655 Glen Erin Dr, Mississauga, ON L5N 3L4, Canada
